about: Limits and word lists for facet-rule-fixer. scripts/facet_rule_plan.py reads this file, so change a rule here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; SKILL.md and references/change-format.md say how the plan's checks block or warn.

notes.max_changes_per_batch: At most this many ready creates, updates and switch-offs go into one batch, with one yes; more go into further batches. Each switch-on and each delete is always a batch of its own and doesn't count here.
notes.sync_checks: After each write, read the rule back with get_facet_rule up to this many times (a few seconds apart) until syncStatus is SUCCESS, then run verify.
notes.finished_statuses: Experiment statuses known not to be running, compared case-insensitively. Every other experiment, including one with no status or an unknown one, counts as possibly running: a change whose rule, query or category is in one of its buckets is blocked, and a global change is blocked by any of them.
notes.never_show_words: A facet whose name contains one of these (compared lower-case) is commercial or internal: a change that would boost, bury or always show it is blocked. Hiding it is always allowed.
